summary: Apply IoT, energy management, ESG data, and OT security practices to building operations. Explore the five-day smart buildings course.
lede: Smart building operations training helps real estate and facilities professionals use connected-system data to guide building performance decisions. Participants practise mapping sensor-to-decision workflows, establishing energy baselines, and assessing operational technology security exposure. The course also covers ESG data registers and occupant-response processes, with exercises in prioritising improvements and reporting progress to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: Smart buildings training suits professionals responsible for building performance, property technology, energy data, occupant services, and the security of connected facilities. It is designed for people who translate building-system information into operational decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate, facilities, building operations, energy management, BIM, or OT systems is recommended. No coding is required. You do not need access to a live building management system to complete the course exercises.
